intro: Gilshalan Windwalker tasks young defenders in Shadowglen with recovering an unhatched spider egg from deep inside Shadowthread Cave. Having gathered samples of their venom, he needs living specimens to study the unnatural aggression afflicting Teldrassil's wildlife. Securing an unhatched clutch allows researchers to study the creatures safely without subduing full-grown arachnids.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study. Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young adventurer. And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!
But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.
There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave. Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, friend? Did you find a spider egg?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good. I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here. I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, friend. You have been a great help to me.
